title: Freyalise Casts the World Spell
summary: A vast magical undertaking helps bring Dominaria’s Ice Age to an end.
narrative: The Ice Age was sustained by more than ordinary climate conditions. Magical disruptions continued to affect the plane long after the Brothers’ War.
Freyalise’s World Spell played a decisive role in ending that era, allowing Dominaria to move toward a period of thaw and renewal.
